steps: Add marinade ingredients into a ziplock bag and mix to combine.
Tenderise chicken breasts then place in the ziplock bag and mix thoroughly, then set aside for 20 minutes to an hour.
If not marinating, combine the dry spices, pat chicken breast dry and season both sides with spice rub.
Heat oil in a wide skillet over medium-high heat - once shimmering, add the chicken smooth side down.
Cook chicken uncovered on this smooth side for 3-4 minutes until golden.
Flip chicken, reduce heat to low and add ¼ cup of water to skillet then cover with lid (or aluminium foil).
Once chicken reaches 75°C internal at the thickest point, cut the heat and transfer to a plate, covered loosely, to rest for 5 minutes.
Slice into pieces, drizzle with pan drippings and serve!

notes: Change up the marinade / rub to suit the dish you're cooking!

recipe_info.title: Pan Seared Chicken Breast
recipe_info.intro: A simple and versitile pan seared chicken breast that can be adapted to many dishes. Either marinate in a ziplock bag ahead of time or dry rub with spices to cook right away.
